items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: And I heard him a lot of times. And that was Steve Lewis.

ctx.x: Now, who were some of the good piano players in either solo or band that you'd say were really outstanding here?

Well, Dick, that's what I'm trying to tell you. We didn't use none. And it was very similar. I was around in it to find out who was the good. Now, the one I really choose was really good. And I heard him a lot of times. And that was Steve Lewis. See? Because I heard him a lot.
Well, I don't hear any arguments on him, man.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Well, I worked with Tranchinas with him.

ctx.x: Well, I worked with Tranchinas with him.
